data.body: AC10 ISF crash fixed (RED-first). Root cause: run_admission dispatched ISF (an in-session-log finder) to the inline eval solver, which raises ValueError, crashing the whole run mid-way after several admits. Fix: authoritative constant eval_solver.INLINE_UNADMISSIBLE_CRITERIA={ISF}; run_admission now SKIPS those (records a not-inline-admissible drift entry, marks processed so resume replaces not duplicates); also closed latent provider_parity._runnable gap (was returning True for ISF). Two RED-first tests added (test_isf_criterion_is_skipped_not_dispatched; ISF assertion in provider_parity _runnable test), both confirmed RED via neutralize/restore then GREEN. make lint + make typecheck clean (32 unit tests pass). Committing under 67aa, pushing to Gerrit.
